content.text: A modern tourism platform connecting travelers with authentic Kenyan experiences - from wildlife safaris to cultural immersion and eco-tourism adventures.
Built with Next.js 15, React 19, and TypeScript on the frontend, with Django 5.2 and PostgreSQL on the backend. Features multi-language support, GIS integration, and JWT authentication.
The platform includes smart search functionality, interactive maps powered by PostGIS, a complete booking system, and comprehensive admin panel for package and user management.
